note: Flood classification levels (metres) keyed by BOM station number. Most entries are scraped from the 'Flood Classification Levels' line of each station's BOM river height plot page (source='bom_station_plot_page', source_url). datum='AHD' when BOM prints 'm AHD', otherwise 'LGH' (local gauge height, the same gauge datum as the bulletin reading). Levels are null where BOM publishes none. Entries with source='user' are community estimates set by the map maintainer (not official BOM); the updater never overwrites them. checked = date last fetched or set (AEST).
